observed: The near pavers have visible three-dimensional weathered edges and granite grain, but the rounded height transition is too large and makes the slabs appear inflated.
Upright moss triangles are apparent in native subfrustum output.
Lower side eaves were raised too far and compress the two-eave separation.
correction: Reduce actual arris drop from 28 to 15 mm, reduce the crown and independent tilt, replace upright moss flags with closed low cushions, lower side-eave correction by 300 mm, and return the deep rear gable to cedar.
